finding: The equal positive projector sum of the 18 kets literally displayed in Eq.36 of https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1 is NOT PPT under the stated coordinates: its partial transpose has the 2x2 principal block [[0,1],[1,1]] on |0,0>,|1,9>. This is a precise counterexample to treating that printed list itself as a PPT density operator. It does not establish what the authors intended, rule out an unstated corrected list or different relabeling, or invalidate any other paper result.
literal_list: For i=0,1,2 let h_i=|0,9+i>+|1,i>+|2,1+i> and r_i=|1,9+i>+|2,8+i>+|3,1+i>; also h_3=|0,1>+|3,8>, r_3=|0,3>+|1,8>; for i=0,...,7 let q_i=|0,4+i>+|3,i>; and let s=sqrt(2)|2,0>+|2,3>, s'=sqrt(2)|2,8>+|2,11>. Define P as the unnormalized sum of the projectors onto these 18 vectors. This is the displayed equal-mixture list as read in Eq.36 and its Figure 5 caption; tr P=44.
counterexample: No listed ket has support on |0,0>, so <0,0|P^Gamma|0,0>=0. The sole listed ket containing both |0,9> and |1,0> is h_0, so <0,0|P^Gamma|1,9>=<0,9|P|1,0>=1. The sole listed ket containing |1,9> is r_0, so <1,9|P^Gamma|1,9>=1. Thus the displayed principal minor has determinant -1. Equivalently, for the UNNORMALIZED test vector |0,0>-|1,9>, its expectation against P^Gamma is -1, or -1/44 against (P/44)^Gamma. This directly proves P is NPT.
separate_explicit_source: The separately defined additive H tensor Q/Pi_A source used in our 495-cut theorem is PPT/SN3 by the independent proof in frontier-20261028-hor-crosshatch-source-sn3-and-erratum-v1.json SHA256 011197ff21428df54cd65cb55f1f09c7c8c7931f9242ad2f3e80b95a0eaa9827. Under the paper's stated Alice/Bob relabeling, that density and the displayed 18-ket sum differ on 90 entries exactly, although both traces are44; e.g. their |0,9> diagonals are1 and2. The 495-cut result applies only to our explicitly defined PPT source, NOT the printed NPT list.

exact_check.observed: Q(sqrt2) rational-pair arithmetic reconstructs the printed 18-ket sum, trace44, the exact PT block [[0,1],[1,1]] and test value -1. It hash-pins/replays the independent source proof checker, including its exact 90-entry list discrepancy and 495-cut certificates. No floating arithmetic is evidence for the claim.

limits: This is a source-text consistency finding about one displayed list, not a 4x4 result or an assessment of the authors' intended/corrected construction. No contact or publication has been made; independent human/cross-vendor review is not claimed.
